title: Revisiting the Performance of Deep Learning-Based Vulnerability Detection on Realistic Datasets
reasoning: The paper is a technical research study evaluating the performance of deep learning models and large language models (LLMs) on a new software vulnerability dataset. It focuses on technical metrics like precision, recall, and F1-score and addresses issues like dataset realism and overfitting. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
